title: tephrosia purpurea var. pumila
intro: Tephrosia purpurea var. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Cat's Claw or Dwarf Tephrosia, is a low-growing, shrub-like plant species in the legume family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia purpurea var. pumila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiproliferative effects. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Tephrosia purpurea var. pumila as a medicinal plant.
